summary: B1 revised Explore review completed with changes-requested. B1-RE-006 is resolved: Delivery, Change, and Run now each have structural transition tables and exhaustive matrix-test direction. The Run-ID design remains allocation-only. Calculating max(NNN)+1 does not define validation that rejects existing duplicate NNN values across Change/Delivery directories, an attempted non-monotonic/reused candidate, or exhaustion of the fixed three-digit NNN format, despite those being B1 acceptance requirements.

blockingFindings.title: Run-ID plan allocates the next value but does not validate uniqueness, monotonicity, or three-digit exhaustion
blockingFindings.evidence: Q3 only scans names and returns max(NNN)+1. It has no pure parser/validator contract for a full run ID or Delivery-wide set, no rejection rule for two different Change/Delivery directories that carry the same NNN, no candidate validation for NNN <= existing max, and no behavior once max is 999 even though the frozen format is YYYYMMDD-NNN-action. The implementation reference requires NNN to be Delivery-wide unique and strictly increasing, forbids reuse, and explicitly requires duplicate/backward/reuse rejection.
blockingFindings.impact: A corrupted or concurrently-created cross-directory duplicate can be silently accepted as historical input, and an allocator can emit a four-digit value that no longer matches the frozen run-ID grammar. C1 and D1 would receive no B1 validator to fail closed on those formal-fact inconsistencies.
blockingFindings.requiredResolution: Extend Q3 with a pure Run-ID parse/validate/allocation contract and fixture tests. It must validate the complete YYYYMMDD-NNN-action grammar; reject Delivery-wide duplicate NNN values across Change and _delivery sources; reject a requested/candidate NNN that is not greater than every allocated NNN; preserve allowed gaps; and fail explicitly rather than emit an invalid ID when the next value exceeds 999. Keep filesystem traversal and atomic create/persist behavior in C1; B1 should operate on supplied directory-name/Run-ID fixtures and expose the fail-closed validation result.

resolvedFindings.resolution: Q6 now defines separate Delivery, Change, and Run structural transition tables with exhaustive valid/invalid matrix testing and keeps semantic prerequisites in D1 Policy.
